text: I just got my dream job! I can't believe it! This is amazing!
Today was a terrible day, everything seemed to go against me.
The way he talked to me is unacceptable. I'm so angry.
The strange noise at midnight kept me awake out of fear.
I was completely surprised to see her at the party.
The weather is quite nice today, nothing special happened.
Finally, the month-long project is complete. What a relief!
I really miss home and feel lonely being here by myself.
Why do I always have to take responsibility for other people's mistakes?!
That horror movie was truly haunting. I still feel scared.
The test results were much better than I expected. That's incredible!
I need to buy some groceries for dinner tonight.
